entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need to return an item I bought last week.
I can certainly help you with that. To start, could I get your name and order number?
Sure, the name is Mark Rivera, and the order number is VF88-19264.

Thank you, Mark. I see your order for the ProFit Jersey, delivered on January 5th. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered my usual size, but it's the wrong size for me. The jersey is just too tight across the shoulders and chest.

I understand completely. Sizing can sometimes be tricky with performance apparel. Since you're well within the 90-day return period for apparel, we have a couple of options. We can process a full refund, or I can set up an exchange for a different size right now. There's no cost to you for the shipping on the exchange.

Okay, an exchange for a larger size would be perfect. Now, since I do have to repackage this and drop it off, and I'll be waiting a few more days for the new one, would it be possible to get a small discount code for the inconvenience? Maybe 10% off a future order?

I appreciate you asking, Mark. While I can't offer a discount code for a standard sizing exchange, I can confirm the return shipping is completely covered by us. I can email you a prepaid label immediately, so the process is as smooth as possible for you.
Alright, I thought it was worth a shot. A free exchange is still a good deal. Let's go ahead and do that. I'll need a size Large.

Excellent. I've just processed the exchange for a size Large ProFit Jersey to your address on file. The prepaid return label for the medium jersey is on its way to your email right now. As soon as we see the return has been dropped off with the carrier, we'll ship out your new one.
Perfect, that was easy. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with for your VeloFit gear today?
Nope, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
